messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a link/image flap in the onboarding docs after yesterday's CDN switch. A cluster of anchors under /runtime/examples/ now 404 or jump to the wrong section. Can someone take a quick sweep? I can do a small bulk PR but want owner sign-off before touching localized pages. @emma?

ben: Could you drop one or two failing URLs so I can run a quick grep?

maria: Sure — one example: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/examples#rapid-batching -> goes to top of page instead of the anchor. Also images under /assets/onboarding/* are returning 403 intermittently.

ben: Got it. Quick ripgrep to find anchors that reference that slug:
```bash
ripgrep "runtime/examples#rapid-batching" -n docs/ || true
```
I can run a scan and produce a list.

emma: Thanks for the ping. I'm the partial owner for onboarding. If it's a canonical slug change from the CDN, we should prefer redirect entries rather than mass-editing localized files. I can review the list tonight.

ryan: FYI, product is doing a tiny doc deploy at 11:30am PT — recommend holding any big rename PRs until after. Small sed patches for broken internal anchors are fine.

maria: Good call. I'll prepare a targeted PR for non-i18n files first (small sed). Sample sed to fix anchors if the fragment changed from rapid-batching -> rapid-batching-v2: 
```bash
rg "#rapid-batching(?!-v2)" -l docs/ | xargs -n1 sed -i "s/#rapid-batching/#rapid-batching-v2/g"
```
I'll run against a grep list and open a draft PR.

tara: docs-bot scan caught 24 anchor mismatches and 8 image 403s in the onboarding tree this morning. Paging @emma for ownership review. :eyes:

docs-bot: scan results — anchors: 24 mismatched; images: assets/onboarding (8 files with 403s); suggested action: add redirects for canonical slugs + small PR for internal cross-links. Report ID: scan-615000.

emma: OK I'll take ownership of the redirect approach. Maria — please open the draft PR with just the cross-link fixes (non-localized). Add me as reviewer and include the ripgrep output as a file. I'll add redirect mappings in the redirects bucket if we confirm slug changes.

maria: Will do. Draft PR link when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben: If anyone wants the scan results CSV, ping me and I'll paste it in the thread.

ryan: Thanks — appreciate the coordination. Once redirects are in place we can schedule a small follow-up to notify localization owners.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421 (draft) — contains 16 sed fixes in /runtime/examples and a ripgrep-output.txt. Left i18n dirs untouched. @emma PTAL when you can.

emma: Reviewing now. If patterns look good I'll promote to ready and coordinate redirects. :shipit:
